# LiTT

> LiTT is an AI workspace for law firms and legal departments in Mexico (document review, drafting, legal research, tabular review). It is a modified version of MikeOSS (AGPL-3.0-only). Closed beta by invitation at https://litt.asteroitt.com. Each firm's documents, matters and keys are separated from other firms' by row-level security. Users bring their own model keys (BYOK); the one platform service is an optional citation support check that each person can turn off.

Repository: https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt (issues are disabled; code proposals go through pull requests). Production deploys are tagged `prod-YYYYMMDDx` in Git, each pointing to the commit that runs; most are also published as a GitHub release. Every build embeds its commit; the app links to that source (AGPL-3.0 section 13).

Current production deploy: `20261117g` (commit `cca74bf67`, tag `prod-20261117g`).

Read first: the repository's agent rules and the current state. Local setup uses synthetic data only. Production state and open items change; check PROJECT_STATUS.md before relying on them.

## Start here

- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for agents working in this repository
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/README.md): every document, one line each, grouped by purpose
- [Project status](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md): production deploy, what is on and off, open items
- [Release gates](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/RELEASE_GATES.md): the gates before production
- [Technical debt](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/TECHNICAL_DEBT.md): authoritative open debt with exit criteria

## Product features

- [Firm profile](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/firm-profile.md): the firm description the assistant reads
- [Playbooks](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/playbooks.md): negotiation guides turned into reviewable rules
- [Training](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/training.md): mentors, pupils, supervision and criterion
- [Document conversion](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/document-conversion.md): Markdown, Word and PDF into a new document
- [Document comparison](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/document-compare.md): two Word files into a new one with tracked changes
- [Scan reading (OCR)](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/document-ocr.md): optional, with the person's or firm's own key
- [Split a case file](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/document-split.md): one PDF into one file per document
- [Client profile](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/client-profile.md), [matter requests](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/matter-requests.md), [deadline radar](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/deadline-radar.md), [obligation rules](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/obligation-rules.md), [retainer report](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/retainer-report.md): retainer-matter features
- [Citation support check](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/citation-support-check.md): silent second check of citations, per-person opt-out
- [Connectors (MCP)](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/connectors.md): hosted presets and custom servers
- [LiTT MCP server](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/mcp-server.md): OAuth authorization server and `/mcp` for AI apps (on in production since 2026-11-17, release `20261117c`)
- [Word add-in](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/word-addin/README.md): Microsoft Word task pane

- [Backend architecture](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/backend-architecture.md): domain modules over a shared kernel

- [Local development](https://github.com/IvanJS17/litt/blob/main/docs/local-development.md): Docker Compose stack with synthetic data
